tools.name: create_2d_mockup
tools.description: Create a reusable photo mockup from a public image URL. Returns the mockup ID and public render targets synchronously. Costs 25 credits. If the image is unsuitable, the 25 credits are refunded automatically. Set is_async=true to queue instead and receive a job_id to poll with get_job or wait_for_job. Use the dashboard for visual fine-tuning.

source_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the product image

name.description: Optional display name for the photo mockup

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry-stable key for this create request

is_async.description: Queue creation instead of waiting. When true the API returns 202 with a job_id immediately -- poll with get_job, or call wait_for_job to block until it finishes and returns the mockup. Default false returns the mockup synchronously (201).

tools.name: create_photo_mockup
tools.description: Create a reusable photo mockup from a public image URL. Returns the mockup ID and public render targets synchronously. Costs 25 credits. If the image is unsuitable, the 25 credits are refunded automatically. Set is_async=true to queue instead and receive a job_id to poll with get_job or wait_for_job. Use the dashboard for visual fine-tuning. Family-name spelling of create_2d_mockup: one tool under two names, same arguments, same behavior. Either name works.

source_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the product image

name.description: Optional display name for the photo mockup

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry-stable key for this create request

is_async.description: Queue creation instead of waiting. When true the API returns 202 with a job_id immediately -- poll with get_job, or call wait_for_job to block until it finishes and returns the mockup. Default false returns the mockup synchronously (201).

tools.name: create_upload_url
tools.description: Get a place to send a file that only exists on your machine. Every other tool takes a URL, so a local file has to be uploaded first. Returns an upload_url to PUT the bytes to and the file_url they will have afterwards; pass that file_url as psd_file_url to upload_psd, or as artwork_url to any render tool. Set kind to "psd" for a .psd or .psb template, or "artwork" for a .png, .jpg, .webp or .gif image. The upload target is scoped to a single file and cannot be overwritten or read back through the same URL. When the file is on the machine running this server, upload_local_file uploads it in one step. Costs 0 credits.

filename.description: The file's name, e.g. shirt.psd. Only its extension is read, and a type that cannot be processed is refused.

kind.description: "psd" for a .psd or .psb template, "artwork" for a .png, .jpg, .webp or .gif image.

tools.name: create_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Register a webhook endpoint that SudoMock calls when async jobs finish. The signing secret is returned IN FULL exactly once here -- store it to verify the HMAC carried in the X-SudoMock-Signature header (with X-SudoMock-Timestamp) on incoming deliveries. URL must be https and publicly routable.

url.description: https endpoint URL to receive POST deliveries (publicly routable; private/loopback hosts are rejected)

event_types.description: Event types to subscribe to. Supports render, upload, video, photo mockup create (photo_mockup.*), photo mockup render (photo_mockup_render.*), and webhook.test events; the legacy 2d_mockup.* / 2d_render.* spellings of the photo mockup events are accepted too. Pass an empty array (the default) to subscribe to ALL events.

event_naming.description: Which spelling of the photo mockup events this endpoint receives: 'current' (photo_mockup.*, photo_mockup_render.*, kind photo_mockup_create/photo_mockup_render) or 'legacy' (2d_mockup.*, 2d_render.*, kind 2d_create/2d_render). Omit to let event_types decide: 'current' when it names photo mockup events by their family names only, otherwise 'legacy' (an empty list, a list of events spelled the same either way, or any legacy name). Pick 'legacy' only for a receiver written against the old names.

description.description: Optional human-readable label for this endpoint

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get your account info: the organization the API key belongs to, subscription plan, remaining credits, prepaid balance, usage stats, billing period, and API key details. The plan, credits and balance belong to that organization, so name it when you report them. An account is funded by a subscription allowance or by a prepaid balance, so read both: an account paying as it goes reports 0 credits and pays from its balance. Quote funding_summary rather than reading the credits fields alone.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get the current status of any async render, video, upload, or photo mockup job by its job_id. Returns status (queued|running|succeeded|failed), completed-result details and credits charged, or an error if failed. To block until done, use wait_for_job instead.

job_id.description: The job_id returned by any async submission

tools.name: list_fonts
tools.description: List fonts available for text layers: the shared system catalog plus any fonts you have uploaded. Filter by family name (search), by category (serif, sans-serif, display), or by scope ('all', 'system', or 'custom' for your uploads only); results are paginated (per_page up to 100). Use a font's uuid or postscript_name as the font of a text_layers entry when rendering with render_mockup. Costs 0 credits.

search.description: Filter by family name (case-insensitive contains), e.g. 'sans'

scope.description: Which fonts to return: 'all' (system fonts plus your uploads, the default), 'system', or 'custom' (your uploads only)

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List your async jobs, including PSD renders, videos, uploads, and photo mockup creation and renders, newest first. Use this when you do not already hold a job_id. Pass the returned next_cursor to fetch the next page.

kind.description: Filter by job kind. A photo mockup job has two spellings of its kind (photo_mockup_create / photo_mockup_render, or the legacy 2d_create / 2d_render); either spelling selects both. Omit for all kinds.

mockup_uuid.description: Filter by source mockup UUID (e.g. one mockup's videos). Raw-image videos are never returned by this filter.

cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a prior page's next_cursor

tools.name: list_mockups

created_before.description: Only mockups created before this ISO 8601 timestamp

image_url.description: Public URL of the image (PNG/JPG/WebP) to process

tools.name: render_2d_mockup
tools.description: Render artwork onto a saved photo mockup. Name exactly one target: a print_area_uuid (a bounded zone somebody drew on the product, such as a chest logo; sized by fit or by width + height) or a surface_uuid (a whole printable product, for an all-over print; sized by coverage or by width + height). Read both from get_2d_mockup. Returns print_files (each with an export_path) and a render_uuid. Costs 5 credits. Second name of render_photo_mockup: the same tool and behavior, with the mockup passed as mockup_uuid. Use the dashboard for visual fine-tuning.

mockup_uuid.description: UUID of the photo mockup template (from list_2d_mockups, returned as mockup_id).

artwork_url.description: Public URL of the artwork image (PNG/JPG/WebP) to place on the mockup

remove_background.description: Remove the artwork's background before placing it. Adds 25 credits per artwork.

rotation.description: Rotate artwork in degrees (-360 to 360). Omit to leave it unrotated.

offset_x.description: Pixel offset along the X axis from the anchored position. Omit to sit exactly on the anchor.

offset_y.description: Pixel offset along the Y axis from the anchored position. Omit to sit exactly on the anchor.

position.description: Where the artwork sits within its target. Omit to accept the renderer's anchor, which is the center.

is_async.description: Queue the render instead of waiting. When true the API returns 202 with a job_id immediately; poll with get_job, or call wait_for_job to block until it finishes and hands back result_url. Default false returns print_files + render_uuid synchronously (200). Use for long renders or when running many in parallel.

print_area_uuid.description: UUID of a saved print area from get_photo_mockup's print_areas[] (its print_area_id): a bounded zone somebody drew on the product, such as a chest logo. Omit when surface_uuid is used.

surface_uuid.description: UUID of a product surface from get_photo_mockup's surfaces[]: a whole printable product, for an all-over print. Omit when print_area_uuid is used.

coverage.description: How much of the surface the artwork spans, as a percentage (10-100). Belongs to surface_uuid; sending it with print_area_uuid is refused. Omit to span the whole surface, which is what an all-over print usually wants. Send width and height instead to give the artwork an exact size.

fit.description: How the artwork meets the print area, which it always fills edge to edge: 'contain' keeps the proportions and fits inside (the default), 'fill' stretches to the edges, 'cover' fills and crops the overflow. Belongs to print_area_uuid; sending it with surface_uuid is refused. Leave it out to get 'contain'. To sit inside the area with room around it, send width and height instead.

width.description: Artwork width in pixels, drawn at that exact size instead of by coverage or fit. Send together with height, and without coverage or fit. Width and height are independent, so any aspect ratio is allowed - stretching on one axis only is a supported placement.

height.description: Artwork height in pixels. Send together with width. Sending only one of the two is rejected rather than silently completed, so the aspect ratio is never guessed for you.

blend_mode.description: How the artwork sits on the product: 'multiply' (the default) keeps the material texture visible, 'normal' reproduces the artwork colors exactly. 'screen', 'lighten', 'soft_light', 'overlay' and 'darken' are also accepted.

tools.name: render_mockup
tools.description: Render a PSD mockup with artwork, editable text, or both. Supports one or multiple smart objects and preserves the template's authored appearance. Name what to fill with any of these, alone or together: smart_object_uuid + artwork_url for one smart object, smart_objects entries ({uuid, asset or color}) for one or more, text_layers entries ({uuid, text or segments}), or text_layer_uuid + text for one text layer. Sent together they are combined into one render: the smart_object_uuid entry comes before the smart_objects entries, and the text_layer_uuid entry before the text_layers entries. A call that names nothing to render returns an error. Returns the rendered image URL. Costs 1 credit. Use list_mockups and get_mockup_details to find target UUIDs.

mockup_uuid.description: UUID of the mockup template (from list_mockups)

smart_object_uuid.description: UUID of one smart object layer (from get_mockup_details). Send with artwork_url, or leave both out and use smart_objects or text_layers. With smart_objects, this entry comes first.

artwork_url.description: Public artwork URL for smart_object_uuid. Send the two together, or leave both out and use smart_objects or text_layers.

smart_objects.description: Smart objects to fill, each with a uuid and asset or color. Works on its own; with smart_object_uuid these entries follow that one.

uuid.description: UUID of the smart object layer

url.description: Public URL or data URL of the artwork image

base64.description: Raw base64-encoded artwork bytes without a data URL prefix

content_type.description: MIME type for base64 artwork; defaults to image/png

fit.description: How artwork fills the smart object area

remove_background.description: Remove the artwork's background before placing it. Adds 25 credits per artwork.

hex.description: Color overlay as a six-digit hex code

blending_mode.description: Blend mode for the color overlay

text_layers.description: Text layer overrides from get_mockup_details, each with a uuid and exactly one of text or segments. Works on its own; with text_layer_uuid these entries follow that one.

text.description: Replacement text for a single-style layer

segments.description: Styled-segment replacements for a multi-style layer

font.description: Font UUID or PostScript name for a single-style layer

font_size.description: Font size in pixels at the mockup's native resolution

color.description: Text color as a six-digit hex code

stroke_color.description: One outline color, or up to eight front-to-back outline colors; null keeps an original color

fit.description: Long-text handling for single-style point text; default overflow

text_layer_uuid.description: UUID of one editable text layer from get_mockup_details text_layers. Send with text or text_segments; it becomes one text_layers entry, placed before any text_layers entries sent with it.

text.description: Replacement text for the text_layer_uuid layer when it has one style (segment_count 1). Use text_segments for a styled layer.

text_segments.description: For a styled text_layer_uuid layer (segment_count above 1): {index, text} entries. Listed segments are replaced, the rest keep their text, and each keeps its own styling. Used instead of text.

text_font.description: Font UUID or PostScript name from list_fonts. Single-style layers only. Omit to keep the layer's font.

text_font_size.description: Font size in pixels at the mockup's native resolution. Single-style layers only. Omit to keep the original size.

text_color.description: Text color as a six-digit hex code, e.g. '#1A1A1A'. Single-style layers only. Omit to keep the original color.

text_stroke_color.description: Colors for the text layer's own outlines: one hex code for the front outline, or up to eight front to back; null keeps an authored color. Single-style layers only.

text_fit.description: Long-text handling for single-style point text: 'overflow' keeps the designed size, 'shrink' scales it down to fit, 'clip' cuts it at the last character that fits. Omit for 'overflow'.

text_vertical_align.description: Where text that text_fit 'shrink' scaled down sits in the original area: 'top' (the default), 'center' or 'bottom'. Single-style layers only.

group_layer_uuid.description: UUID of an editable group layer from the mockup's group_layers. Send with group_stroke_color.

group_stroke_color.description: Colors for that group's outlines: one hex code for the front outline, or up to eight front to back; null keeps an authored color. The change affects everything inside the group.

fit.description: How singular artwork_url fills its smart object area

dpi.description: Print resolution metadata (72-2400). Does not change pixel size -- use image_size. jpg/png recommended for widest print-tool compatibility.

remove_background.description: Remove the artwork's background before placing it. Adds 25 credits per artwork.

hex.description: Color overlay as a six-digit hex code

blending_mode.description: Blend mode for the color overlay

text_layers.description: Text layer overrides from get_mockup_details, each with a uuid and exactly one of text or segments. Works on its own; with text_layer_uuid these entries follow that one.

text.description: Replacement text for a single-style layer

segments.description: Styled-segment replacements for a multi-style layer

font.description: Font UUID or PostScript name for a single-style layer

font_size.description: Font size in pixels at the mockup's native resolution

color.description: Text color as a six-digit hex code

stroke_color.description: One outline color, or up to eight front-to-back outline colors; null keeps an original color

fit.description: Long-text handling for single-style point text; default overflow

text_layer_uuid.description: UUID of one editable text layer from get_mockup_details text_layers. Send with text or text_segments; it becomes one text_layers entry, placed before any text_layers entries sent with it.

text.description: Replacement text for the text_layer_uuid layer when it has one style (segment_count 1). Use text_segments for a styled layer.

text_segments.description: For a styled text_layer_uuid layer (segment_count above 1): {index, text} entries. Listed segments are replaced, the rest keep their text, and each keeps its own styling. Used instead of text.

text_font.description: Font UUID or PostScript name from list_fonts. Single-style layers only. Omit to keep the layer's font.

text_font_size.description: Font size in pixels at the mockup's native resolution. Single-style layers only. Omit to keep the original size.

text_color.description: Text color as a six-digit hex code, e.g. '#1A1A1A'. Single-style layers only. Omit to keep the original color.

text_stroke_color.description: Colors for the text layer's own outlines: one hex code for the front outline, or up to eight front to back; null keeps an authored color. Single-style layers only.

text_fit.description: Long-text handling for single-style point text: 'overflow' keeps the designed size, 'shrink' scales it down to fit, 'clip' cuts it at the last character that fits. Omit for 'overflow'.

text_vertical_align.description: Where text that text_fit 'shrink' scaled down sits in the original area: 'top' (the default), 'center' or 'bottom'. Single-style layers only.

group_layer_uuid.description: UUID of an editable group layer from the mockup's group_layers. Send with group_stroke_color.

group_stroke_color.description: Colors for that group's outlines: one hex code for the front outline, or up to eight front to back; null keeps an authored color. The change affects everything inside the group.

fit.description: How singular artwork_url fills its smart object area

dpi.description: Print resolution metadata (72-2400). Does not change pixel size -- use image_size. jpg/png recommended for widest print-tool compatibility.

remove_background.description: Remove the artwork's background before placing it. Adds 25 credits per artwork.

is_async.description: Queue the render instead of waiting for it. When true the API returns 202 with a job_id immediately (no result_url yet) -- poll with get_job, or call wait_for_job to block until it finishes. Use for long renders or when running many in parallel.

tools.name: render_video
tools.description: Create a short AI video from either a mockup with artwork or a public image URL. Supply exactly one input mode. Always async: returns a job_id immediately for get_job or wait_for_job. Credit cost depends on clip length, audio, and the automatically selected quality. Unsupported durations are rejected.

mockup_uuid.description: RENDER MODE: UUID of the mockup to animate (from list_mockups or upload_psd). Required in render mode. In raw-image mode it is an optional association (groups the clip under that mockup's 'Past clips').

smart_object_uuid.description: RENDER MODE: UUID of the smart object layer to place artwork on (from get_mockup_details). Required in render mode; omit in raw-image mode.

artwork_url.description: RENDER MODE: public URL of the artwork image (PNG/JPG/WebP) to place on the mockup before animating. Provide this OR artwork_base64. Omit in raw-image mode.

artwork_base64.description: RENDER MODE: raw base64-encoded artwork bytes (no data: prefix). Provide this OR artwork_url.

artwork_content_type.description: MIME type for artwork_base64 (defaults to image/png if omitted).

image_url.description: RAW-IMAGE MODE: a public https png/jpg URL to animate without a mockup. Supply this OR (mockup_uuid + smart_object_uuid + artwork), never both.

fit.description: RENDER MODE: how artwork fills the smart object area in the still frame

asset_width.description: RENDER MODE: custom artwork width in pixels (overrides fit sizing).

asset_height.description: RENDER MODE: custom artwork height in pixels (overrides fit sizing).

asset_top.description: RENDER MODE: artwork top offset in pixels within the smart object area.

asset_left.description: RENDER MODE: artwork left offset in pixels within the smart object area.

duration_seconds.description: Clip length in seconds. Unsupported values are rejected. Longer clips cost more credits.

audio.description: Generate audio. Default off; enabling it may cost more credits.

motion.description: 'ambient' = subtle looping hero motion that keeps the print readable; 'showcase' = one deliberate camera/product move.

advanced_model.description: Advanced override for the automatic quality selection. Unsupported values are rejected. Omit for automatic selection (recommended).

image_format.description: Output format of the still input frame

image_size.description: Width in pixels of the still input frame (default 2048)

quality.description: Compression quality for the still input frame (webp/jpg, default 90)

webhook_url.description: Optional completion webhook URL. Best-effort push; polling get_job remains the source of truth.

tools.name: replay_failed_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Re-send every failed or dead delivery for a webhook endpoint in one call, e.g. after fixing your endpoint. Returns status and count: how many deliveries were queued to be sent again. To re-send a single delivery, use replay_webhook_delivery.

endpoint_id.description: The id of the webhook endpoint whose failed deliveries are all sent again (from list_webhook_endpoints)

tools.name: replay_webhook_delivery
tools.description: Replay a single webhook delivery while preserving its event identity, e.g. after fixing your endpoint. Get delivery_id from list_webhook_deliveries.

endpoint_id.description: The id of the webhook endpoint (from list_webhook_endpoints)

delivery_id.description: The id of the delivery to replay (from list_webhook_deliveries)

tools.name: rotate_webhook_secret
tools.description: Rotate the signing secret for a webhook endpoint. A new secret is returned IN FULL exactly once -- update your verifier with it. The old secret stops being valid.

endpoint_id.description: The id of the webhook endpoint to rotate (from list_webhook_endpoints)

tools.name: send_webhook_test_event
tools.description: Send a signed webhook.test event to verify endpoint reachability and signature handling. Returns a test job_id; check the result with list_webhook_deliveries. Second name of test_webhook_endpoint: one tool under two names, same arguments, same behavior. Either name works.

endpoint_id.description: The id of the webhook endpoint to test (from list_webhook_endpoints)

tools.name: test_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Send a signed webhook.test event to verify endpoint reachability and signature handling. Returns a test job_id; check the result with list_webhook_deliveries.

endpoint_id.description: The id of the webhook endpoint to test (from list_webhook_endpoints)

tools.name: update_2d_print_areas
tools.description: Replace a photo mockup's print areas with up to 8 four-point quads and return the updated geometry. An empty list is accepted only for verified full product surfaces. Costs 0 credits.

mockup_id.description: UUID of the photo mockup to update

points.description: Four [x, y] points in top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left order

name.description: Optional display name for this print area

print_areas.description: Replacement print areas (0-8 four-point quads, each with an optional name)

tools.name: update_mockup
tools.description: Rename a mockup template.

mockup_uuid.description: The UUID of the mockup to rename

name.description: New display name for the mockup

tools.name: update_photo_mockup_print_areas
tools.description: Replace a photo mockup's print areas with up to 8 four-point quads and return the updated geometry. An empty list is accepted only for verified full product surfaces. Costs 0 credits. Family-name spelling of update_2d_print_areas: one tool under two names, same arguments, same behavior. Either name works.

mockup_id.description: UUID of the photo mockup to update

points.description: Four [x, y] points in top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left order

name.description: Optional display name for this print area

print_areas.description: Replacement print areas (0-8 four-point quads, each with an optional name)

tools.name: update_psd_mockup
tools.description: Rename a mockup template. Family-name spelling of update_mockup: one tool under two names, same arguments, same behavior. Either name works.

mockup_uuid.description: The UUID of the mockup to rename

name.description: New display name for the mockup

tools.name: update_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Update a webhook endpoint in place: change its url, description, subscribed event_types, its event_naming pin, or enable/disable it (enabled:false pauses deliveries without losing the signing secret). All fields optional -- only the ones you pass are changed. The secret is NOT rotated or returned here.

endpoint_id.description: The id of the webhook endpoint to update (from list_webhook_endpoints)

url.description: New https endpoint URL (publicly routable; private/loopback hosts are rejected)

event_types.description: Replacement list of subscribed event types. Pass an empty array to subscribe to ALL events.

event_naming.description: Re-pin which spelling of the photo mockup events this endpoint receives: 'current' (photo_mockup.*, photo_mockup_render.*, kind photo_mockup_create/photo_mockup_render) or 'legacy' (2d_mockup.*, 2d_render.*, kind 2d_create/2d_render). Omit to keep the endpoint's current pin. Sent on its own, the re-pin re-spells the stored subscription list to match. Move an endpoint to 'current' only once its receiver handles the new names.

enabled.description: Set false to pause deliveries (secret preserved), true to resume

tools.name: upload_local_file
tools.description: Upload a file from this machine and get back a URL for it. Use this when the file exists on disk and a tool needs a URL: pass the returned file_url as psd_file_url to upload_psd, or as artwork_url to any render tool. Set kind to "psd" for a .psd/.psb template or "artwork" for a .png/.jpg/.webp/.gif image. Costs 0 credits.

file_path.description: Path to the file on this machine. Relative paths resolve against the server's working directory.

kind.description: "psd" for a .psd or .psb template, "artwork" for an image.

tools.name: upload_psd
tools.description: Upload a Photoshop PSD/PSB file as a new mockup template. The PSD must have at least one Smart Object layer. Processing takes 5-30 seconds.

psd_file_url.description: Public URL to a .psd or .psb file (up to Adobe's official PSD file size limit)

psd_name.description: Display name for the template (auto-generated from filename if omitted)

is_async.description: Queue the upload instead of blocking. When true the API returns 202 with a job_id immediately -- poll with get_job (or wait_for_job) to learn when processing finishes and get the new mockup_uuid. Always free (0 credits), sync or async.

tools.name: wait_for_job
tools.description: Poll any async render, video, upload, or photo mockup job until it succeeds or fails, then return the final result and credits charged. Blocks while polling.

job_id.description: The job_id to wait on (from an async submission or render_video)

timeout_seconds.description: Give up after this many seconds if the job has not finished (5-900, default 300)
